# `attitude-budget`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.38.0, family [Mission analysis, links and space operations](../mission-analysis-links-and-space-operations.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

3-DOF attitude & pointing error budget: the worst-case gravity-gradient disturbance torque ((3/2)(μ/R³)ΔI) and a root-sum-square pointing-error budget over named 1σ contributors (sensor noise, reaction-wheel jitter, thermal, alignment) with the dominant term, for an orbit altitude + body inertia spread. MODELLED scalar AOCS budget — a pre-hardware complement to Basilisk/42, not a control-loop/6-DoF/flexible-mode simulation.

One run of `scenarios/attitude-budget.toml` summarises as: attitude-budget: 600 km, ΔI 40 kg·m² -> GG torque 7.04e-5 N·m; pointing 10.7" RSS (dominant: reaction_wheel_jitter) (MODELLED scalar budget)
